text: Tata Sons Private Limited's Annual Report 2024-25 lists Tata Consultancy Services Limited (India) among its subsidiaries with a percentage of ownership interest of 71.76% as at 31 March 2025.

source.name: Tata Sons Private Limited: One Hundred and Seventh Annual Report 2024-25, notes to the consolidated financial statements (non-controlling interests)
source.note: Annual report for the financial year 2024-25; the PDF carries no explicit publication date. The quote is the Tata Consultancy Services Limited row of the table in Note 57 (non-controlling interests; partly owned subsidiaries), whose columns are 'Percentage of ownership interest*' and 'Percentage of ownership interest held by Non controlling interest' as at 31 March 2025 and 2024; Note 58's subsidiary list shows the same 71.76% ownership.
